text: Aerospace science and technology was established successively in the early and mid-20th century and developed rapidly. It involves numerous disciplinary fields, including knowledge from mathematics, mechanics, chemistry, power engineering and engineering thermophysics, which interpenetrate and interpenetrate in aerospace applications, forming a complete disciplinary system. The main research directions of this discipline include aircraft design, aerospace propulsion theory and engineering, aerospace manufacturing engineering, human-machine and environmental engineering, etc. Its development level is a manifestation of a country's comprehensive national strength and directly reflects the degree of modernization of its science and technology, national defense construction and national economy.
